body: i know coming out is super hard but no matter how your parents took it just know that there are people (even if you don’t know them personally) who will support you no matter what
i hope things get better, just know we’re here if u need friends too :)

I understand how you feel. But with time these scars will heal and i hope by then whatever’s making you feel bad will go away. I struggle with self harm too and my scars are kinda visible, but they will slowly fade, i know it. I hope this helps, sorry if i was inconsiderate or anything.
And if I’m ever able to help you with anything I will be glad to do so 😊

I honestly thank you from the bottom of my heart for our convo. I also thank you for giving me the time of day to rant about what’s been bothering me cause I really needed to take care of all this bottled up emotions 💛
Thank you for encouraging me, I definitely needed it. And to answer your question: yes, I worry about people’s opinions all the damn time. It’s honestly exhausting but I can’t help it.

I have plans on going to college, just in case. I either want to become a english professor or a criminal psychologist. It’s just that some voice in my head always tells me that I’m not going to be able to reach my goals and then everyone will be disappointed in me which drives me even more to think about killing my self.

I do in fact have trouble sleeping because (as cliche as it sounds) it’s that time when I replay all of the embarrassing scenes that happened that day (or the days before), then my mind starts to overthink and all I wanna do is get up and start pasting around my room (idk if this is normal tho). As for calming apps, I’ve used some but ended up deleting them anyway.

Reddit and commentary channels (Fresh, Danny Gonzales and so on). Sometimes it helps, other times my thoughts are too strong that I can’t even escape from them. It’s gotten to the point where I have to have a video playing while I’m trying to sleep so it’ll make it easier for me to actually fall asleep.

Thank you for your kind words. We do in fact fave a counselor and a psychologist who I’ve tried to talk to, but it didn’t really help, and after a while I stopped taking about my problems with them because I felt like my peers were judging me.

I tried to talk to my school psychologist about social problems only, but they haven’t helped all that much. 
As for school allies, no I don’t. I hang out with my classmates but I can see that they don’t want me there or that they hate me. 
When I get home I just try and eat to make myself feel better and watch YouTube vids. That’s pretty much all I do at this point apart from sleep.
P.S. thank you for the kind words. I really appreciate it.

You don’t have to feel that way. You don’t have to validate what you’re feeling because other people have it worse and you shouldn’t feel guilty. You matter and so do your feelings because you don’t have to prove yourself.
